test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the sportsperson who received the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021 in the wrestling discipline from the following options.
solution:
The correct answer is " **Ravi Kumar** ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravi Kumar **received the** Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** 2021 in the wrestling discipline .
 
• He also won a **silver medal** in the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• He is also a **three times Asian champion** in wrestling.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nishad Kumar** is an **Indian Paralympian and high jumper**.
 
• **Sharad Kumar** is an **Indian para high jumper**.
 
• **Suhash Yathiraj** is an **Indian para badminton player**.
